import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from the database
conn = sqlite3.connect('qualtrics.db')
cursor = conn.cursor()
cursor.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';")
tables = cursor.fetchall()

if tables:
    table_name = tables[0][0]
    print(f"Loading data from table: {table_name}")
    df = pd.read_sql_query(f"SELECT * FROM {table_name}", conn)
    conn.close()
    
    print(f"\nDataset shape: {df.shape}")
    print(f"Number of columns: {len(df.columns)}")
    
    # Separate numeric and categorical columns
    numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(exclude=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
    
    print(f"\nNumeric columns ({len(numeric_cols)}): {numeric_cols}")
    print(f"Categorical columns ({len(categorical_cols)}): {categorical_cols}")
    
    # Initialize anomaly tracking
    anomalies = {
        'missing_values': {},
        'outliers': {},
        'data_type_issues': {},
        'unique_value_issues': {}
    }
    
    # Per-cell statistics and anomaly detection
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("PER-CELL STATISTICS AND ANOMALY REPORT")
    print("="*80)
    
    # 1. Missing values analysis
    print("\n1. MISSING VALUES ANALYSIS:")
    missing_counts = df.isnull().sum()
    missing_percent = (missing_counts / len(df)) * 100
    
    for col in df.columns:
        if missing_counts[col] > 0:
            anomalies['missing_values'][col] = {
                'count': int(missing_counts[col]),
                'percentage': round(missing_percent[col], 2)
            }
            print(f"   {col}: {missing_counts[col]} missing values ({missing_percent[col]:.2f}%)")
    
    if not anomalies['missing_values']:
        print("   No missing values found in any column.")
    
    # 2. Numeric columns analysis
    print("\n2. NUMERIC COLUMNS ANALYSIS:")
    if numeric_cols:
        numeric_stats = df[numeric_cols].describe()
        print("\n   Summary statistics:")
        print(numeric_stats)
        
        # Outlier detection using IQR method
        print("\n   Outlier detection (IQR method):")
        for col in numeric_cols:
            Q1 = df[col].quantile(0.25)
            Q3 = df[col].quantile(0.75)
            IQR = Q3 - Q1
            lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR
            upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
            
            outliers = df[(df[col] < lower_bound) | (df[col] > upper_bound)][col]
            if len(outliers) > 0:
                anomalies['outliers'][col] = {
                    'count': len(outliers),
                    'percentage': round((len(outliers) / len(df)) * 100, 2),
                    'min_outlier': float(outliers.min()),
                    'max_outlier': float(outliers.max())
                }
                print(f"   {col}: {len(outliers)} outliers ({len(outliers)/len(df)*100:.2f}%)")
    else:
        print("   No numeric columns found.")
    
    # 3. Categorical columns analysis
    print("\n3. CATEGORICAL COLUMNS ANALYSIS:")
    if categorical_cols:
        for col in categorical_cols:
            unique_count = df[col].nunique()
            print(f"\n   {col}:")
            print(f"     Unique values: {unique_count}")
            print(f"     Most frequent value: {df[col].mode().iloc[0] if not df[col].mode().empty else 'N/A'}")
            
            # Check for high cardinality
            if unique_count > 50:
                anomalies['unique_value_issues'][col] = {
                    'issue': 'High cardinality',
                    'unique_count': unique_count
                }
                print(f"     ⚠️  High cardinality warning: {unique_count} unique values")
            
            # Check for mixed data types
            if df[col].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, (int, float))).any():
                anomalies['data_type_issues'][col] = {
                    'issue': 'Mixed numeric and string values'
                }
                print(f"     ⚠️  Mixed data types detected")
    else:
        print("   No categorical columns found.")
    
    # 4. Structured anomaly report
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("STRUCTURED ANOMALY REPORT")
    print("="*80)
    
    total_anomalies = sum(len(v) for v in anomalies.values())
    print(f"\nTotal anomalies detected: {total_anomalies}")
    
    if total_anomalies > 0:
        for category, issues in anomalies.items():
            if issues:
                print(f"\n{category.upper().replace('_', ' ')}:")
                for col, details in issues.items():
                    print(f"  • {col}: {details}")
    else:
        print("\nNo anomalies detected in the dataset.")
    
    # 5. Visualization of key statistics
    print("\n" + "="*80)
    print("VISUALIZATION OF KEY STATISTICS")
    print("="*80)
    
    # Create visualizations if there's data
    if len(df) > 0:
        fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15, 10))
        
        # Missing values heatmap
        if missing_counts.sum() > 0:
            missing_matrix = df.isnull()
            axes[0, 0].imshow(missing_matrix, aspect='auto', cmap='viridis')
            axes[0, 0].set_title('Missing Values Pattern')
            axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Columns')
            axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Rows')
        
        # Numeric distributions
        if numeric_cols:
            df[numeric_cols].hist(ax=axes[0, 1], bins=20)
            axes[0, 1].set_title('Numeric Columns Distribution')
            axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Value')
            axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency')
        
        # Correlation heatmap for numeric columns
        if len(numeric_cols) > 1:
            corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
            im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
            axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Matrix')
            axes[1, 0].set_xticks(range(len(numeric_cols)))
            axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(numeric_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
            axes[1, 0].set_yticks(range(len(numeric_cols)))
            axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(numeric_cols)
            plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
        
        # Categorical value counts (top 10)
        if categorical_cols:
            top_cat = categorical_cols[0] if categorical_cols else None
            if top_cat and df[top_cat].nunique() <= 20:
                value_counts = df[top_cat].value_counts().head(10)
                axes[1, 1].bar(range(len(value_counts)), value_counts.values)
                axes[1, 1].set_title(f'Top 10 Values in {top_cat}')
                axes[1, 1].set_xticks(range(len(value_counts)))
                axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(value_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
                axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
        
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
    
    print("\nAnalysis complete. All statistics and anomalies have been reported.")
    
else:
    print("No tables found in the database. Cannot perform analysis.")
    conn.close()
